notes: The 57-stage Arrow Chart is a discovery ledger/registry of stage types, not a universal chronological timeline.
Where historical text says a closed Sequence reopens, canonical rule is: create a new Sequence referencing the closed one.
Where historical text conflates entity termination with Sequence closure, canonical rule keeps two statuses separate.
The old nine loops are route templates, not a universal fixed count.
Assimilation and Integration are one conditional incorporation/integration operation unless a domain proves two distinct transitions.

phase2.goal: Adopt Human, AI, Holy Book, ASI and other domain native registries into the Universal Sequence grammar without rewriting native IDs, then bind them to ASI Nodes/Node Brains.
